subject: Hosted evaluation follow-up — deployment path & ratecap questions
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Richards <sam.richards@clearfleet.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation follow-up — deployment path & ratecap questions

Hi Sam — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap + a few targeted questions so we can size the right onboarding path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC). I want to keep this short and make sure we line up the operational constraints up front.

Recap (what we showed):
- Redwood Hosted API: quick sandbox access, streaming + function calls, automatic prefix/KV caching, and built-in rate caps per endpoint.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools with predictable throughput and SLA-backed targets.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-controlled network and optional KMS/HSM integration for full key control.

Questions we need from you to recommend the right path:
1) Traffic profile: expected steady-state RPS and expected peak burst (per minute / 5-min). Typical token lengths (avg prompt / avg completion).
2) Latency SLO: p95 target (ms) and whether sub-200ms p95 is required.
3) Data sensitivity: any PHI/PCI? Do you require customer-managed keys or can you accept Redwood-managed KMS?
4) Residency & compliance: is EU data residency required now or later? SOC 2 Type II / other attestations needed?
5) Contract asks: any specific SLA or indemnity clauses the legal team will push back on? We attached a draft SLA and our quickstart one-pager to make this concrete.

Proposed next step (if Hosted looks ok):
- We provide sandbox keys + a 2-week quickstart (limited token budget, pre-configured endpoints).
- We’ll instrument per-endpoint rate caps and a suggested prefetch/KV cache config based on the traffic profile you send.
- If you prefer Dedicated, we’ll size a reserved pool and provide throughput/latency estimates.

Could you reply with answers to 1–4 this week? If you want, we can run a short technical check-in with your infra/security folks to validate KMS and network constraints.

Attaching: redwood-quickstart-one-pager.pdf, SLA-draft.pdf

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Sam Richards <sam.richards@clearfleet.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ClearFleet Legal <legal@clearfleet.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation follow-up — deployment path & ratecap questions

Sean — great walkthrough yesterday, appreciate the clarity. Answers inline below. I copied our legal team as they will want to read the SLA draft.

1) Traffic profile: initial rollout is narrow (customer support triage). Expected steady-state: ~8 RPS (concurrent single-token equivalent requests), with predictable daily peaks around 45–60 RPS and an anticipated marketing-driven burst up to ~140 RPS for short windows (1–3 minutes). Avg tokens: prompt ~80 tokens, completion ~120 tokens.

2) Latency SLO: We’d like p95 <= 300ms for the user-facing endpoint. Sub-200ms would be great but not required initially.

3) Data sensitivity: No PHI or PCI in the initial scope. We do want customer-managed encryption keys at the time of production (so Private or Dedicated with KMS integration is preferred long-term). For the POC we can accept Redwood-managed KMS provided data is isolated and logs can be audited.

4) Residency & compliance: Primary user base is US. EU residency may be required in a future phase (Q2 next year). We need SOC 2 Type II and a short list of compliance evidence (retention controls, audit log details).

Contract asks: Legal flagged a couple of SLA points — they will redline the indemnity paragraph and ask for clarity on data deletion timelines. I expect a first-pass redline by Friday.

Next: We are inclined to try Hosted quickstart to validate UX and latency. Please provision sandbox keys and a small token package and we’ll run a 2-week trial. Also schedule a 30-min tech sync with our infra lead (I’ll introduce them in the next email).

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Richards
Head of Product — ClearFleet
sam.richards@clearfleet.com | +1 646-555-0199

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation follow-up — deployment path & ratecap questions

Sean / Rafael — quick internal note after Sam's answers.

- Traffic profile looks small-to-midsize but with short high bursts (~140 RPS). We should propose a Hosted quickstart configuration that enforces per-endpoint burst caps plus auto-burst policy to protect latency.
- Rafael: can you spin up a cost sketch for a 2-week hosted POC with the following assumptions: steady 8 RPS, 2 daily peaks at 60 RPS for 15 min, one marketing burst at 140 RPS for 3 min; token mix as Sam listed. Also include an estimate if they convert to Dedicated (monthly commit) for baseline 20k req/day.
- Security: Sam accepted Redwood-managed KMS for POC but will want customer-managed keys for prod. Rafael, please include notes on what we can offer for KMS/HSM integration and expected lead time.

I’ll prep the sandbox provisioning checklist (IP allowlist, token limits, sample prompt set) and send to Sam once Rafael's cost sketch is ready.

—Monica

Sam — perfect, thank you for the quick answers and for looping in legal. Action plan & asks below so nothing falls through the cracks:

1) Sandbox + quickstart: we’ll provision a Hosted sandbox with 2-week access, a limited token package, and one streaming endpoint configured for your support workflow. Expect sandbox credentials within 24 hours once you confirm the infra contact.

2) Tech sync: please introduce your infra lead and legal contact in a reply-all. I’ll propose two 30-min slots tomorrow and Friday morning.

3) Docs & SLA: I’ve uploaded the SLA draft to the DocuSign preview (link below) so legal can redline directly. We’ll accept tracked redlines and aim for a response within 48 hours after receiving them.

4) Sample traffic: can you drop a small sample CSV with 200 representative requests (prompt + expected completion length) to a shared drive? That will let Rafael tune the caching/batching and give a more accurate cost estimate.

DocuSign SLA preview: https://www.docusign.net/clarify/CF-SLA
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890

Next steps for us (internal): Rafael to send cost sketch; Monica to send sandbox provisioning checklist; Sean to provision sandbox on confirmation.

Thanks again — looking forward to the POC.

Best,
